scripts.build: tsc -b packages/db packages/domain apps/worker && npm run build -w @demo/contracts && npm run build -w @demo/api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @demo/contracts && npm run dev -w @demo/api
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @demo/contracts && node --import tsx --test packages/contracts/test/*.test.ts apps/api/test/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:api && npm run build
scripts.db:types: dotenv -- sh -c 'supabase gen types typescript --db-url "$SUPABASE_DB_URL" --schema public' > packages/db/src/types.ts
